# watchpoint_sso_configuration (Resource)

A tenant SSO configuration (SAML or OIDC). The client secret and SAML certificate are write-only and are never read back from the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_sso_configuration" "example" {
  connection_name         = "Entra ID SSO"
  provider_type           = "EntraId"
  domain                  = "example.com"
  client_id               = "your-app-id"
  oidc_authority          = "https://login.microsoftonline.com/tenant-id/v2.0"
  oidc_client_secret      = var.oidc_client_secret
  oidc_scopes             = "openid profile email"
  group_claim_name        = "groups"
  jit_provisioning_enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_type` (String) SSO provider type. One of `EntraId`, `Okta`, `GoogleWorkspace`, `SamlGeneric`, `OidcGeneric`, `PingFederate`, `Adfs`.

### Optional

- `client_id` (String) OIDC client ID.
- `connection_name` (String) Display name for the connection.
- `default_role_id` (String) Role assigned to JIT-provisioned users by default.
- `domain` (String) Email domain associated with the connection. Must be a verified domain.
- `enforce_sso_only` (Boolean) Whether to require SSO for sign-in. Defaults to `false`.
- `group_claim_name` (String) Name of the claim carrying group memberships. Defaults to `groups`.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the connection is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `jit_provisioning_enabled` (Boolean) Whether just-in-time user provisioning is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `oidc_authority` (String) OIDC authority / issuer URL.
- `oidc_client_secret` (String, Sensitive) OIDC client secret. Write-only: not refreshed on read.
- `oidc_scopes` (String) Space- or comma-separated OIDC scopes. Defaults to `openid profile email`.
- `saml_certificate` (String, Sensitive) SAML signing certificate (PEM). Write-only: not refreshed on read.
- `saml_entity_id` (String) SAML entity (issuer) ID.
- `saml_signing_algorithm` (String) SAML signing algorithm.
- `saml_sso_url` (String) SAML SSO (sign-in) URL.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) SSO configuration ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_sso_configuration.example sso_001
```
